stages.title: Ground-floor ICF
stages.desc: Nudura 6in XR35 ground-floor ICF walls as populated (6in Std internal walls), with the opening end caps and lintel bucks.

stages.title: First-floor steel and hollowcore
stages.desc: S-101 first-floor steel cast into and bearing on the ground-floor ICF, the posts and connections, the 150 hollowcore floor and the main stair (GF to FF).

stages.title: First-floor ICF
stages.desc: First-floor ICF walls on the ground-floor ICF and the hollowcore, with their openings, the second-floor box walls and the gables to the rafter line.

stages.title: Second-floor steel and joists
stages.desc: S-102 second-floor steel on the first-floor ICF, the joists between the steel and the Simpson Strong-Tie ICF ledgers on the box walls.

stages.title: Roof steel
stages.desc: S-103 roof steel (mansard frames, purlins, gable rafters and ridges).
